summary: Design, review, and measure governed prompt libraries for CX, sales, and marketing. Explore the five-day practical course.
lede: Enterprise prompt library governance helps customer experience, sales, and marketing teams organize reusable AI instructions and manage them through review. Participants practice classifying prompts, documenting ownership and approved uses, setting review steps, testing outputs, and tracking adoption and quality. It is designed for professionals responsible for customer-facing AI workflows and includes draft governance artefacts they can adapt to their teams’ processes.
audienceIntro: This prompt library course is for professionals who own or influence customer-facing AI content and workflows. It suits cross-functional teams responsible for prompt design, operational controls, quality review, and reporting.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with at least one CX, sales, or marketing workflow that uses or may use generative AI is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring examples of existing prompt use or content workflows if your organization permits sharing them; remove confidential or personal information.
